post.description:
One authenticated POST produces one SSE stream; it is never replayed.

The run belongs to the server, not to the connection: if the reader
disconnects or stalls, the run still finishes and saves its answer, and
``/api/chat/{session_id}/run-state`` reports it active until then. Only
``POST /api/chat/{session_id}/stop`` cancels it. Clients must not
automatically retry with a fresh request UUID after an uncertain network
outcome; read owned chat history instead.

post.summary: Embed texts (BETA — deterministic fallback, unverified quality)
post.description: **BETA/unverified. BOLD: good WSD ≠ good embeddings.** Ruh was trained for sense disambiguation, not retrieval — embedding quality is completely unproven and the ArabicMTEB-style eval is still pending. Current vectors come from a deterministic token-hash fallback (stable placeholder, NOT a trained embedding) so integrations can be built against the API shape. Do not use for production retrieval.

post.summary: Disambiguate a word's sense in context (with provenance)
post.description:
Word-in-context → verified sense, with a provenance receipt naming the computed signals behind the decision.

PROVISIONAL — read before relying on this endpoint:
• Scoring is deterministic context-overlap over the versioned sense inventory (Q-CSMP v2, 96 senses, 48 lemmas). The trained-model signal is NOT wired yet (see the `model` provenance signal: it only appears when a classifier posterior was actually mixed in).
• The Q-CSMP pilot reported accuracy 0.7592 (95% CI 0.7241–0.7927) on minimal-pair data with keyword-rule labels. Real prose is harder; 12/88 rare senses had 0 recall; no external benchmark exists. Independent eval is pending — treat every confidence as provisional.
• Arabic glosses (`gloss_ar`) are null until scholar-reviewed. The inventory never invents them.
• Conservative abstention: confidence below threshold → `status: 'uncertain'`, `sense_id: null`, with alternatives. Thresholds are tiered — 0.6 general, 0.8 religious/Quranic-flagged.

Deterministic rule-based morphology (Bayan tables). Accuracy vs CAMeL Tools UNVERIFIED — eval harness ruh_model/eval/morphology_eval.py (separate track) pending. Confidence is heuristic/unverified, never calibrated.

get.description: Reports whether root tables loaded and whether trained model weights are available. Deterministic rule-based morphology (Bayan tables). Accuracy vs CAMeL Tools UNVERIFIED — eval harness ruh_model/eval/morphology_eval.py (separate track) pending. Confidence is heuristic/unverified, never calibrated.

post.summary: Screen a document for Sharia-salient spans (flagging only)
post.description: **PILOT/BETA — unverified.** No buyer verified (research 2026-09-29). Flags Sharia-salient spans (e.g. riba/gharar/maysir-adjacent language) for scholar review. **The model never issues rulings**: requests asking for a fatwa/ruling/hukm are refused, and `ruling` is always null. **Scholar review required** for every flagged document before any downstream use. Flags in v0.1 are lexical, not model judgments.

200.description: Refusal object or flag list with ruling=null.

task.title: Task
task.description: Task to route to best agent

instruction.title: Instruction
instruction.description: Extra guidance, e.g. 'focus on the verb forms'.

paragraph.title: Paragraph
paragraph.description: The ONLY source the answer may use.

note.title: Note
note.default: BETA/UNVERIFIED: root/pattern are rule-based heuristics and per-occurrence senses are scholar-eval pending (see ruh_model/reader/annotator.py). Do not present as verified tafsir.

MultimodalInput.title: MultimodalInput
MultimodalInput.description: Input for multimodal perception analysis (text + image + audio).

dialect_hint.title: Dialect Hint
dialect_hint.description: Region hint; omit for auto-detect (may misattribute)

NormalizeRequest.title: NormalizeRequest
NormalizeRequest.description: One dialectal word to normalize into root-space.

note.title: Note
note.default: BETA/UNVERIFIED: deterministic affix tables + rule-based analyzer; never evaluated on real dialectal text (NADI/MADAR eval pending). Do not use for consequential decisions.

OAuthClient.title: OAuthClient
OAuthClient.description:
A client registered with the authorization server beforehand (no dynamic
registration): its ID, an optional secret (sealed) and the scopes to ask for.

Qwen3RerankInfo.title: Qwen3RerankInfo
Qwen3RerankInfo.description: Provenance for the optional Qwen3 sense rerank (null when not applied).

ReaderInstall.title: ReaderInstall
ReaderInstall.description:
A version of MIZAN's own reader trained and gated elsewhere, read from a
Hugging Face model repository at a pinned commit.

age_16_or_older.title: Age 16 Or Older
age_16_or_older.description: The person confirms they are 16 or older.

scope.title: Scope
scope.default: Text-based tajwīd analysis for Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim (ash-Shāṭibiyyah). Not audio/ASR based; other qirāʾāt are flagged, never computed. The engine does not guess vowels: full analysis needs tashkīl.

SpendingLimits.title: SpendingLimits
SpendingLimits.description: USD limits; null removes that limit (the server or admin limit applies).

root.title: Root
root.description: Trilateral root (e.g. ك-ت-ب as كتب), null when none.

lemma.title: Lemma
lemma.description: Citation form when tables provide one.

diac.title: Diac
diac.description: Diacritics only if present in the input; never invented.

WorkspaceUpdate.title: WorkspaceUpdate
WorkspaceUpdate.description: A new name, goal and/or the project's protected paths (an empty list protects nothing).

text.title: Text
text.description: Arabic (or mixed) text to analyze, 1..20000 chars.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'deterministic' returns the argmax analysis per token; 'nbest' adds scored runner-up candidates per token.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: 'quranic' applies conservative confidence (capped) and low-confidence flags — a wrong Quranic analysis is not a normal bug.

qiraat.title: Qiraat
qiraat.description: Qirāʾah. Only 'hafs' is implemented; anything else is rejected.

status.title: Status
status.description: 'ok' (full analysis) or 'partial' (no diacritics: letter-shape rules only)

scope.title: Scope
scope.default: Text-based tajwīd analysis for Ḥafṣ ʿan ʿĀṣim (ash-Shāṭibiyyah). Not audio/ASR based; other qirāʾāt are flagged, never computed. The engine does not guess vowels: full analysis needs tashkīl.
